messages.author: Jenny 148
messages.body:
Dear all,
I have carried out pc analysis on the wildtype and mutant of the same
protein. I have carried out separate pc analysis and now want to compare
the subspaces spanned by these.
Is it okay to do an rmsip calculation on the mode 1 of each of these
trajectories?
Or is it advisable to do these only if we do a combined pc of within a
single trajectory?
Any help is greatly appreciated.
Regards,
Jenny
